newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 7.35 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 7.35 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 14.0 trillion lire 30-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 7.35 percent, compared with 8.01 percent at the previous repo tender on November 28, the Bank said.
The average rate was 7.45 percent against 8.03 percent at the last repurchase pact for 5.0 trillion lire and 15 days.
The pact takes effect today or tomorrow and the securities are for resale on January 2, 1997. The Bank said it received 46 bids of which 30 were met in full and eight in part.
